title: Staff briefing synthesis — cross-team engineering (2026-03-25)
body:
Purpose
Quick synthesis of cross-team engineering staff meeting (weekly leadership sync). Focus was alignment across Serving Runtime, Dedicated, Private, and Console teams for the next 2 sprints. This doc is deliberately light — capture decisions, open questions, and owners for follow-up.

Attendees
Asha (Platform Eng), Lena (Serving Runtime), Marcus (SRE), Priya (Product - Console & Rollouts), Ethan (Dedicated infra), Jamie (Observability). Several others joined for specific agenda items (list in Slack thread).

Agenda (runtime order)
1) Exec summary & hot topics (Asha)
2) Serving runtime perf regressions and mitigation timeline (Lena)
3) Dedicated capacity onboarding checklist + rollout blockers (Ethan)
4) Console rollouts: canary automation and tracing hooks (Priya)
5) Observability costs & retention tradeoffs (Jamie)
6) Cross-team risk register + 1-2 prioritized mitigations
7) Action items and owners

Key notes & decisions
- Perf regression: identified a 7% p99 CPU regression for long-sequence inference on specific quantized kernels after kernel update (profile in REDWOOD-3421). Immediate decision: disable new kernel on prod pool A and route traffic to previous kernel until patch is validated. (Owner: Lena; ETA: 48h)
- Dedicated onboarding: internal beta with three customers is progressing but autoscaler instability observed under ramp test (sustained 250 qps). Decision: pause new customer onboarding until autoscaler fix lands in next release. Temporary workaround: reserve static spare nodes for onboarding customers to avoid failed capacity scale-ups. (Owner: Ethan; ETA: 5 business days)
- Console canary automation: agreed on incremental rollout policy template — all canaries must run end-to-end trace verification and prompt-set regressions before 10% traffic shift. Priya to produce template and a small SDK snippet for ops teams. (Owner: Priya; ETA: next Tue)
- Observability retention: raised cost pressure; Jamie proposed tiered retention (token-level by route for 30d, aggregated 90d, cold storage 1y). Teams agreed in principle; need quant model. Jamie will run cost/benefit and propose pricing for advanced retention. (Owner: Jamie; ETA: 2 weeks)

Open questions / risks noted
- Private deployment installs (on-prem) still lack standardized KMS integration docs — customers hit integration pain. Risk: slower private uptake. Owner: Platform Eng docs squad to produce a one-page KMS quickstart. (Owner: Asha / Docs; ETA: 7 business days)
- Model fallback policy interactions with Dedicated autoscaler (edge case): when fallback triggers a model variant with higher memory footprint, autoscaler may not have capacity -> degraded p50/p95. Need a simulation (small load test matrix) to measure fallback cost. (Owner: Serving Runtime + Dedicated; ETA: next sprint)
- Eval coverage: Optimize team flagged incomplete prompt sets for multi-turn agents. Risk: regressions slip through model changes. Action: create shared prompt-set repo and assign ownership per product domain. (Owner: Product & Applied ML; ETA: 10 days)

Action items (owner — due)
- Lena: rollback kernel change on prod-pool-A and run validation matrix, document root cause. Due: 2026-03-27
- Ethan: implement temporary static spare node config for onboarding cluster; coordinate with SRE to monitor. Due: 2026-03-30
- Priya: deliver canary rollout template + SDK snippet; add example to Console docs. Due: 2026-03-31
- Jamie: cost model for retention tiers and recommended default. Due: 2026-04-08
- Asha / Docs: KMS quickstart one-pager for private installs. Due: 2026-03-31
- Serving Runtime + Dedicated: design load-test matrix for fallback interactions; share results in next leadership sync. Due: 2026-04-07
- Product & Applied ML: create shared prompt-set repo and propose domain owners. Due: 2026-03-29

Quick standups / team-specific blurbs (notes to share with each team)
- Serving Runtime (Lena): focus this week on kernel patch validation, add more perf counters around kv-cache eviction behavior. Small spike: evaluate alternate quantized GEMM kernel from community fork (low priority).
- SRE (Marcus): monitoring alerts tuned for autoscaler flapping; investigating noisy SLO alerting causing paging at 0200. Will add noise-filtering rule and update runbook.
- Dedicated (Ethan): autoscaler fix in progress; manual capacity reservations added as temporary safety net. Need a postmortem for the last onboarding failure.
- Console (Priya): shipping rollback-safe canary framework; working with runtime to surface trace IDs in Console UI.
- Observability (Jamie): focusing on storage tiering prototype; will demo costs profile next week.

Quick wins and low-risk asks
- Small script to annotate canary results with failing prompt IDs — Priya to accept contributions from runtime team (help wanted: 2 people for 1 day).
- Docs sprint: triage top-10 private-deployments questions into short pages (Asha). Volunteers: Lena, Priya.

Unresolved / parking-lot items
- Internal SLA language for Dedicated customers re: fallback behavior under overload (legal to weigh in).
- Long-term autoscaler design: consider queuing vs dropping incoming requests during ramp. Need architecture deep-dive session.

Meeting retrospective (how the sync went)
- Good: quicker decision-making, clear owners assigned. Better cross-team context than last week.
- Could improve: pre-shared perf artifacts (profiling traces) were incomplete; ask teams to attach full flamegraphs before meeting.

Next meeting agenda suggestions (add to Slack thread)
- Follow-up on kernel patch + perf validation
- Autoscaler postmortem + roadmap (Ethan + Marcus)
- Canary automation demo (Priya)
- Retention cost model review (Jamie)

Notes to self (Asha)
- Pull together a short executive blurb for Friday all-hands summarizing the Dedicated pause and mitigations (1–2 bullets).
- Escalate KMS doc priority with Docs lead; mention customer ticket count this week.

Links & artifacts referenced
- REDWOOD-3421: perf regression details (profiling + kernels)
- REDWOOD-3580: dedicated onboarding failure ticket
- Runtime PR #459: tentative kernel changes (do not merge until validation)
- Slack thread: #platform-leadership  (search: "staff briefing 03/25")

If you see missing context or want items to be moved to the top of next agenda, add a comment in the Slack thread or ping me directly.

-- Asha
